title: Late-Layer Geometric Resistance Under In-Context Knowledge Conflict
description: A workshop-note-scope interpretability finding: late-layer decoherence under in-context knowledge conflict is real and replicates across three model architectures on isolated single-sentence contradictions, but mostly does not survive realistic multi-sentence documents (5 of 6 relations reverse sign). Two proposed mechanisms (per-fact memorization rigidity; active-lie commitment) are tested directly and refuted. Includes full reproduce scripts.
